title: Bronze by gold, miss Douce’s head by miss Kennedy’s head
html_source:
This marks the end of the ‘introductory’ section of Sirens. The two women are barmaids : Miss Lydia Douce and Miss Mina Kennedy. They are fictional (Gifford, D. Ulysses Annotated, p295) although Joyce did know real people called Douce and Kennedy, (Ellmann).

The repition of the sounds which constitute ‘head’ identicate a freestanding nature to the organ.
